user_prompt: Our finance team currently uses our lease accounting system to track IFRS 16 liabilities and right-of-use assets, but we have no automated way to reconcile the lease modification adjustments that our real estate and equipment procurement teams make throughout the year against what's been recorded in our general ledger—we're manually reviewing dozens of modification notices each quarter and trying to match them to journal entries, which creates audit risk and delays our month-end close.

steps.step_name: We need an automated reconciliation capability to match lease modification adjustments made by our real estate and equipment procurement teams against the journal entries recorded in our general ledger for IFRS 16 liabilities and right-of-use assets.
